info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Status API provides real-time access to the status of parking reservations within the system. It allows users to query and retrieve the current states of their parking reservations, facilitating better management and planning for parking needs. This API is particularly useful for businesses that manage parking spaces and need to keep stakeholders informed about reservation statuses. Typical consumers include parking lot operators, fleet managers, and application developers integrating parking functionality into their platforms.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the current status of your reservations. You can check if your reservations are confirmed, pending, or canceled, providing valuable information for managing your bookings efficiently.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of reservations. This body should contain all necessary information to query the reservation status effectively.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current reservation status.

ListParkingReservationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to reservations status.

status.description: Indicates if the operation was successful.

resultId.description: An identifier for the resulting operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the reservation was created.
